status: Design field lists, not deployable schemas. Resolve exact versions, cardinalities, state-specific requirements and consumer tests before enabling.

contracts.name: ProgramDefinition
contracts.invariant: Program configuration does not assert that accounts satisfy it.

contracts.name: AudienceDefinition
contracts.invariant: Selections record their input snapshot; broad facts persist even for rejected targets.

contracts.name: OfferDefinition
contracts.invariant: Named service/offer policy; not proof of prospect pain or an implemented automation playbook catalog.

contracts.name: AccountSeed
contracts.invariant: Unresolved seeds remain provisional; neither a redirect nor source label proves domain ownership.

contracts.name: LeadSelection
contracts.invariant: Fit and exclusion decisions are not evidence strength or source authority.

contracts.name: ResearchPlan
contracts.invariant: Missing evidence results in a bounded plan or explicit defer, never a fabricated fact.

contracts.name: ContactProfile
contracts.invariant: Identifiers, evidence, and operational view remain separate; KN-01 owns canonical identity.

contracts.name: ContactAssessment
contracts.invariant: Deliverable endpoint does not imply appropriate recipient or outreach permission.

contracts.name: MessageArtifact
contracts.invariant: Exact recipient-visible factual content must be reviewed. Channel rendering cannot add unsupported assertions after package review.

contracts.name: CampaignDefinition
contracts.invariant: Exactly one scheduler owns progression; campaign activation is separate from creation or review.

contracts.name: CampaignApproval
contracts.invariant: Does not substitute for a package ReviewDecision or per-effect current-use/send authorization.

contracts.name: CampaignReadiness
contracts.invariant: Readiness is time-sensitive; provider drift can block dispatch despite prior approval.

contracts.name: Enrollment
contracts.invariant: Same recipient/account can be constrained across campaigns. State changes use expected revisions and event identities.

contracts.name: StepEligibility
contracts.invariant: Scheduling eligibility is not SendGateDecision; final current restrictions are checked again before dispatch.

contracts.name: DeliveryIntent
contracts.invariant: Stable business intent across retries and code upgrades; altered payload under same effect is an error.

contracts.name: SendGateDecision
contracts.invariant: New proposed family. Existing UseGateDecision supports export purposes only. Recheck immediately before effect; no indefinite gate caching.

contracts.name: SenderCapabilitySnapshot
contracts.invariant: Secrets remain protected references; do not assume a provider supports idempotency, cancellation, or exact content preservation.

contracts.name: DeliveryAttempt
contracts.invariant: Transport completion and remote acceptance are separate; ambiguous acceptance requires reconciliation, not resend.

contracts.name: Conversation
contracts.invariant: Reply chains link exposures without guessing causal attribution for analytics; unmatched events remain visible.

contracts.name: ReplyAssessment
contracts.invariant: Model labels are inferences; pause/opt-out controls do not wait on or take permission from model confidence.

contracts.name: EnrollmentControl
contracts.invariant: ENG-01 requests stops; CAM-02 applies them idempotently. Authorized restrictions are written separately by PLAT-02.

contracts.name: FollowUpTask
contracts.invariant: Creating a human task is not authorizing an automated follow-up, referral send, or calendar action.

contracts.name: SalesHandoff
contracts.invariant: A positive reply is not a confirmed meeting, won sale, or permission to invent additional factual qualifications.

contracts.name: CRMMapping
contracts.invariant: Each field has one authority or an explicit merge policy; use versions/receipts, not unrestricted last-write-wins.

contracts.name: CRMAccountView
contracts.invariant: Imported pipeline data is a current provider report. Stale critical exclusions cause refresh or hold, not automatic reactivation.

contracts.name: CRMSyncIntent
contracts.invariant: No delivery commands in CRM write retries; emit approved record mutations only.

contracts.name: CRMSyncReceipt
contracts.invariant: Record ambiguous writes and reconcile without duplicating tasks or deals; missing data cannot release DNC.

contracts.name: ExperimentDefinition
contracts.invariant: Label observational versus randomized designs explicitly; no promised causal conclusions.

contracts.name: ExperimentAssignment
contracts.invariant: Pin before exposure; deduplicate and track cross-campaign contamination.

contracts.name: QualityAssessment
contracts.invariant: Quality outcomes do not alter source authority by themselves; preserve fixture versus live-evaluation distinction.

contracts.name: PromotionProposal
contracts.invariant: Proposal only. Authorized governance and release compiler publish a new immutable release for later runs.

contracts.name: WorkspaceView
contracts.invariant: Read model only; user actions must route through authenticated owning operations.
